description: This file defines the ILogViewAdaptorHost interface used in the Orleans framework for log-view consistency. It specifies methods for updating views and handling state changes within grains implementing log-view consistency.

classes.name: ILogViewAdaptorHost
classes.description: Interface for grains utilizing log-view consistency, providing callbacks for view updates and state change notifications with generic types for log view and log entries.

methods.name: UpdateView
methods.description: Callback to update the log view with a new view and log entry.

methods.name: OnViewChanged
methods.description: Notifies the host about changes in view state, specifically tentative and confirmed states.
